description: NSW COVID-19 public transport routes (discontinued) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Ministry of Health. The data is for confirmed COVID-19 cases on public transport routes that have been classified by NSW Health for action. Refer to the latest COVID-19 news and updates for information on action advice provided by NSW Health. See the Transport for NSW website for COVID-19 safer travel guidance. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Ministry of Health. Its tags are bus, coronavirus, covid, covid19, locations. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
